title: Swirl Room
tagline: An oddly satisfying toy box of fluid, lava, sand and slime that runs in your browser.
stateNote: Playable now on phone or desktop. The Terrarium world simulator inside it is the deepest part.
problem: Sometimes you just want something to push around. Swirl Room is a set of tactile toys where the physics, graphics and sound are all generated live, with no libraries.
audience: Anyone with a spare minute and a touchscreen or mouse, and people who like seeing how much can fit in one HTML file.
contribution: It is my project. The whole app is one self-contained page, and the repository builds and deploys it to GitHub Pages.
worksToday: Eight toys: fluid, lava, sand, cymatics, slime, domino, swing and pop.
Multi-touch works on phones, and keys 1 to 8 switch toys on desktop.
Terrarium is a sand-based world simulator with dozens of materials, save slots and share codes.
limitations: The fluid toy uses WebGL2, so older devices may struggle.
I checked that the hosted page loads and renders. I haven't tested every toy on every device.
